title: identity.user_registered.v1
description: A person completed registration. Carries no address: notification looks the person up rather than being handed contact details, because an email address is restricted content under data-classification.md and an event reaches analytics too.

account_type.description: Whether they registered alone to practise or created a workspace. The two have different onboarding and different retention.

tenant_id.description: The workspace created alongside the account, for an organisation registration. Absent for a candidate, who has none.
